steps.title: Creatures of Aminishi
steps.text: Charter a ship to Aminishi and talk to Ling.

[Accept Quest]
  • If you have just completed Impressing the Locals, you may need to relog for the chat option to show up.

Kill creatures on the island until you receive 3 books.
  • Ordered from best drop rate to worst, kill Anagami, Sakadagami or Sotapanna.
  • The 3 book names are:
  • The Path of the Dragon
  • The Path of the Monk
  • The Path of the Elemental
  • Pick up some spirit dragon charms because you will need 1-2 later. (Note: Ensure to have toggled off your spirit imp destroy option)
  • The Path of the Dragon
  • The Path of the Monk
  • The Path of the Elemental

steps.title: Spirit realm
steps.text: Enter The Well of Spirits on the middle tier to travel to the spirit realm.
Head south-west and talk to Yulong on the shore. He is exactly where you would find Ling outside the spirit realm.
